title: 两个我三件事，这次我自己选
headline: 两个我，三件事
总得放下一件！
story: 三项邀请撞在周五两点，分身还想再找一个自己，手机却只有一次生成机会。小帅亲自找老师协调，搬桌提前，英语分享由自己完成，这次不报篮球初选。少留一个机会，反而把安排说清了。换作你，会怎样取舍？
scene: Exactly three teenagers in a warm sunlit school corridor: Xiaoshuai in red looks worried while holding ONE clipboard with three simple schedule rows; his identical blue-shirt clone points at the three clashing rows; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman listens beside them with her notebook. A readable humorous contrast between three invitations and just two identical boys. No third clone, no teacher, no phone cloning effect, no trophy.

title: 同桌看见两个我，我决定说实话
headline: 同桌看见两个我
这次，我说实话
story: 同桌看见了两个小帅，分身把经过说得像产品发布会，小帅却承认：自己只是害怕用英语开口。他亲口完成简短自我介绍，也答应向老师和父母说明。坦白之后，同桌愿意听，他也开始听她的广播想法。你紧张时最难说出口的是什么？
scene: Exactly three teenagers beside a classroom desk: red-shirt Xiaoshuai touches his own chest, nervous but sincere while speaking; identical blue-shirt clone stands beside him quiet with a mildly sheepish smile; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman faces them holding a notebook and listens kindly. Warm afternoon school light. Emotional beat is honest explanation, not interrogation or magical memory test. No additional characters, no microphone.

title: 多了一个我，家务也多一份？
headline: 多一个小帅
也多一份碗！
story: 小帅把分身的事告诉老师和父母。学校的职责仍由本人承担，家里则要给多出来的人安排住处，也得分担生活琐事。妈妈一句“两个人，就洗两份碗”，让分身从万能替工变成了家里的合作伙伴。一个洗、一个擦，你觉得怎样分工才合理？
scene: Exactly two identical teenage boys at an ordinary home kitchen sink, warm evening light: red-shirt original Xiaoshuai washes a plain bowl with natural hands; blue-shirt clone dries a second bowl with a cloth, amused expressions and cooperative body language. Their white/teal school jackets can be open or sleeves pushed up. Red and blue inner shirt identity clear. No mother in frame, no extra clone, no giant pile of dirty dishes, no school desk.

title: 休息只有十秒？这场晨跑先暂停
headline: 休息只有十秒？
我先喊暂停！
story: 分身在家拟好晨跑方案，连休息都只留了十秒。小帅到操场先问同学、试跑半圈，才发现纸上的“慢跑”和大家的感受并不一样。他停下秒表，在老师同意后按意愿调整跑步、步行和拉伸。活动有节奏，也要听听参加的人。你喜欢怎样的晨间活动？
scene: Only TWO main teenagers at a school running-track bench in morning light: RED-shirt Xiaoshuai seated holding ONE ordinary black stopwatch, comic tired expression after a short trial jog, deciding to stop the timer; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman beside him makes a gentle suggestion with an open palm. Relaxed school sports setting, no injury or medical emergency. CRITICAL: the BLUE-shirt clone is at HOME and MUST NOT appear anywhere at school in this cover. No other identical boy, no microphone.

title: 分身想包全天，她只要十分钟
headline: 节目排了一整天
先做好这十分钟！
story: 苏小满终于把广播提案讲完：让安静的同学也有机会说出自己的校园故事。分身一来却展开全天节目表，她只圈出一期十分钟。老师原则同意准备试播，要求先交清分工、再检查设备，日期之后再定。第一次合作，你会先做多大？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at a school discussion desk after school: BLUE-shirt clone proudly unfolds ONE long accordion-folded paper schedule draping down toward the floor; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman calmly circles just one small square in red; RED-shirt Xiaoshuai smiles in surprised relief. Paper contains only abstract grid cells, no text. No real broadcast equipment, no microphones or laptop: this is a proposal discussion before equipment testing. Warm school light, funny excessive paper vs tiny useful scope.

title: 分工表上两个小帅，到底谁负责？
headline: 两个小帅都签名
到底谁来负责？
story: 同一个名字在分工表上写了两遍，事情却没说清谁负责。小帅留下来求助，指导老师找到了松动的音频线。三人重新写明主编、统筹和声音协助，各自为自己的工作签名。知道什么时候求助，也是在认真负责。你做小组任务时会先确认什么？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at a broadcast preparation desk: red-shirt Xiaoshuai and blue-shirt clone point to TWO different responsibility rows on ONE form, with one pen resting nearby; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman holds her notebook and checks the form. Two same faces but clear different roles, both have thoughtful rather than boastful expressions. A modest school speaker/control surface can be soft background only. No second form, no new gadgets, no fantasy equipment, no readable prop text.

title: 电脑有波形却没声？先放下采购单
headline: 电脑没坏！
是我们点错了
story: 录音波形明明在，却听不到声音。分身已经列出两页硬件采购单，还挡住了屏幕。小满发现播放轨道被静音，在指导老师帮助下取消静音，同一段试音终于能听见了。设备够用，先把情况看清，再查采访资料。你也遇过这种小误会吗？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at a school computer desk: ONE silver laptop shows abstract audio waveform and a small crossed-out speaker icon, no readable UI text. Blue-shirt clone holds TWO A4 purchase-list sheets of tiny hardware sketches, lowered so they do not hide the laptop; red-shirt Xiaoshuai looks comically surprised at the muted-track icon; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman points to it. Existing small school speaker in background is allowed. No broken laptop, no shopping bags, no invented purchases.

title: 搜了三小时，采访页还是空的？
headline: 搜了三小时
只收藏了聊天群？
story: 三人说好查采访思路，链接却把他们带进社交媒体、搞笑视频和争论。三小时过去，分身收藏了二十个群聊邀请入口，采访页仍几乎空白。小满让每人带回一条有来源的线索，才把准备拉回真实故事。你查资料时，最容易被什么带走？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers in Xiaoshuai's apartment at a home worktable in daytime: ONE silver laptop with abstract many open tabs; ONE black phone in red-shirt Xiaoshuai's hand displays a small cat picture with NO text; blue-shirt clone shows an absurdly long collection of small generic chat-link icons on a paper note; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman looks at a nearly blank interview notebook, rueful smile. Do not imply they joined twenty groups or interviewed twenty people. No desktop microphone, no studio equipment.

title: 戒手机差点把节目也删了？
headline: 为了戒手机
差点删掉节目！
story: 整理分心截图时，分身把节目准备文件夹也一起选中了。删除确认框弹出的瞬间，小帅喊停、按下取消，短试音和口述草稿都还在。三人改为减少提醒、关掉多余标签，再集中准备一个采访故事。少一点打断，不必把成果也清空。你会先关掉哪种提醒？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at the home worktable: ONE silver laptop displays a generic deletion confirmation dialog with only abstract buttons and folder icon, no readable text. RED-shirt Xiaoshuai reaches to the trackpad to CANCEL, startled but in control; BLUE-shirt clone pulls both hands back, sheepish; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman raises a small stop gesture. ONE black phone lies face DOWN to the side. Files are NOT deleted, no shattered laptop, no fire, no new recording gear.

title: 麦克风清单很豪华，钱包不同意
headline: 设备清单很豪华
钱包不同意！
story: 分身的麦克风清单长到地板，小帅的钱包却只剩一枚硬币。老师借来一支普通 USB 麦克风，三人先在安静桌边试录、回听，发现声音已经清楚，决定借用并留下经费。图上的豪华设备不必马上搬到桌上。你的准备清单里，什么才是这次真正需要的？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at a quiet library-side desk: RED-shirt Xiaoshuai opens an ordinary small wallet holding ONE coin and gives a comic incredulous look; BLUE-shirt clone proudly holds ONE very long folded paper list with tiny drawings of fancy microphones, draping downward; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman indicates ONE ordinary black USB hand microphone connected by its cable to ONE silver laptop on the desk. Fancy devices exist ONLY as tiny drawings on the list, not real objects. No phone, no extra mic, no mixer or lighting rig.

title: 我讲第三条，你怎么还在第一条？
headline: 我讲到第三条
你还在第一条？
story: 远程核对采访问题，语音有延迟，分身又边聊边改提纲。小帅讲到第三条，受访同学却还在看新照片的第一条。小满叫停，三人选定“核对版 A”，确认同一顺序，再一条条交接。延迟还在，沟通却能继续。你们的小组讨论也有过版本打架吗？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers at a home worktable: ONE black phone sits flat in speakerphone mode, NO readable screen text. RED-shirt Xiaoshuai holds one three-row question sheet and looks puzzled; identical BLUE-shirt clone holds one newly reordered three-row sheet, realizing the mismatch; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman raises her hand to pause and points to the original ordering. Abstract numbered rows can use 1/2/3 only, no other prop writing. CRITICAL: no laptop, no microphone, no headphones, no cables, and no remote guest physically in the room.

title: 采访台词全背熟，却接不上她的话
headline: 台词背得很熟
却没听见她的话
story: 小帅背好了采访逐字稿，受访同学一讲“不好意思问路”，他却接出预备的励志句。大家同意暂停后，他折起长稿、保留三问，重新问“后来你做了什么”。对方讲完一起求助、没那么孤单的经历，结语也跟着修改。你是在听对方，还是在等自己的下一句？
scene: Exactly FOUR teenage students at a quiet library-side interview desk: red-shirt Xiaoshuai holds an overlong printed script and looks caught off guard, kindly embarrassed; opposite him a BROWN HIGH-PONYTAIL teenage girl with NO glasses smiles with a small questioning gesture. Bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman observes; blue-shirt clone sits at ONE silver laptop helping sound. ONE black wired USB handheld microphone rests on the table between host and guest with one cable to laptop. No phone, no second microphone. Guest must clearly be a teenager in white/teal school jacket, never the mother or teacher. Script contains abstract strokes only.

title: 开播前十秒，怎么先感谢收听？
headline: 开播还剩十秒
怎么先感谢收听？
story: 离第一次试播只剩十秒，小帅翻到的顶卡竟是“感谢收听”。分身检查后把三张卡叠反了。小满恢复卡序，小帅亲口开场，分身等手势播放获同意的采访，老师控制广播通道，十分钟试播终于完成。本集用 6 个重点旧词回顾这段合作。开场前，你会最后检查哪件事？
scene: Exactly three main teenagers in the school broadcast studio just before going on air: RED-shirt Xiaoshuai stares at the TOP of exactly THREE cue cards, top card has the only allowed prop text “感谢收听”; bob-haired round-glasses Xiaoman reaches to put the three cards in order; BLUE-shirt clone pauses by ONE silver laptop and waits for the host's signal rather than speaking over him. ONE fixed desk studio microphone and a modest mixer, no handheld mic. Adult adviser is supervising OUTSIDE the frame, no need to depict her. This is a last-second card ordering mistake, NOT lost files, broken gear or failed broadcast.

title: 妈妈下夜班，我的采访先暂停
headline: 我刚开始录音
我妈刚下夜班
story: 小帅把“八点准备”写成了“八点采访”，妈妈却刚下夜班，想先坐下休息。他停掉自己的开场试音，问早餐想要什么，妈妈笑着答：“安静。”三人收起手机纸笔，改约到她休息后的周日上午，开始前再确认。安排别人的时间前，你会先问哪一句？
scene: Exactly FOUR people in a cozy apartment living room: RED-shirt Xiaoshuai stops ONE black phone test recording on the table, sheepishly realizing the timing; BLUE-shirt clone puts down his pen; bob-haired round-glasses teenage Xiaoman closes her notebook. Mother sits tired but gently smiling on the sofa, BROWN LOW PONYTAIL, CREAM cardigan, SAGE GREEN blouse, NO glasses, one finger softly at lips asking for quiet. A simple breakfast plate and cup are allowed on the table. No laptop, no microphone, no studio equipment, no second phone. Mom is an adult with low ponytail, NEVER the high-ponytail teenage interview guest.
